findings.details: executeAskProject method exists with correct signature. Uses ASK_PROJECT message type and includes projectPath from getProjectPath() and prompt parameter as per design (Requirements 1.1-1.4).

executeAskSpec method exists with correct signature: (specId: string, featureName: string, prompt: string). Uses ASK_SPEC message type and returns Result<AgentInfo, ApiError> as per design (Requirements 2.1-2.4).

executeAskSpec method defined in ApiClient interface with optional marker (?). Signature matches design: (specId: string, featureName: string, prompt: string): Promise<Result<AgentInfo, ApiError>> (Requirements 4.1, 4.2).
Spec Ask button exists in headerAction prop of AgentList. Uses MessageSquare icon with purple styling (text-purple-600) as per design (Requirements 3.1, 3.2).
AskAgentDialog integrated with agentType='spec' and specName={spec.name}. Connected to handleAskExecute which calls apiClient.executeAskSpec (Requirements 3.3, 3.4, 3.5).
On successful executeAskSpec, agent is added to AgentStore via addAgent() and selected via selectAgent(). Dialog closes on success (Requirements 3.6, 3.7).
Error handling implemented with console.error and alert for failed requests. TODO comment indicates future toast system integration (Requirement 3.8).
Unit tests for executeAskProject: verifies ASK_PROJECT message type, projectPath from getProjectPath(), prompt in payload, and AgentInfo return type (Requirement 5.1).
Unit tests for executeAskSpec: verifies method existence, parameter signature (specId, featureName, prompt), ASK_SPEC message type, and Result<AgentInfo, ApiError> return (Requirement 5.2).
Unit tests for Spec Ask button: button rendering, MessageSquare icon with purple color, AskAgentDialog opening, specName prop, executeAskSpec calls, dialog close on success (Requirement 5.3).

details.notes: Implementation uses React 19, TypeScript 5.8+, WebSocket (ws), and Zustand as specified in tech.md. Test files use Vitest as specified.

Files are correctly placed: WebSocketApiClient in src/shared/api/, types in src/shared/api/types.ts, SpecDetailPage in src/remote-ui/components/. Tests are co-located with implementations. Shared stores used for domain state (agentStore in src/shared/stores/).
